bullets.text: Ukrainian President Zelensky has urged the US and Elon Musk to lift Starlink restrictions, stating that current limitations are hindering efforts to counter Russian attacks.
Iran reportedly targeted a US military base in Bahrain with a drone attack, marking the second such incident in three days amid ongoing tensions with the US over the Strait of Hormuz.
A collision between two trains in Egypt resulted in at least seven fatalities and 125 injuries, prompting an immediate investigation ordered by the President.
The ACT government is inviting public feedback on the designs for the new North Canberra Hospital, which reportedly takes inspiration from the local landscape's colours.
A council in Central West NSW has admitted responsibility and will pay $75,000 for discharging untreated sewage into a river, which serves as a drinking water source, for nine days.
Documents reveal that gender-diverse Australian sailors are barred from US submarines despite the AUKUS deal, indicating that the ADF adheres to US directives during training.
Anthropic is poised for the largest IPO in history, positioning its CEO, Dario Amodei, as a central figure in the AI boom and placing significant investor hopes on the frontier model maker.
A new pact signed by the US and its allies aims to protect AI supply chains from China, coming ahead of a meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum.
Peru's economy unexpectedly slowed in September, primarily due to a downturn in its mining and agriculture sectors, indicating challenges in key economic drivers.
